how: Do items in order. pages = PDF pages to read (inclusive); the article may start partway down the first page and the next article may start on the last page. Confirm the chapter from the article's own title (ENARRATIO CAPITULI ...). John Art. I (PDF 277) is on the dignity of St John and his Gospel; PDF 275-276 is a PROOEMIUM: translate it as part of Art. I's note or as its opening, by the sense.
